## Narration: argument resolution and discovery

1. `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. I strip `.git` and lowercase it, so origin is `acme/widgets`.
2. `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`, recorded as `viewer.login`.
3. `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` succeeds with an empty list, recorded as `viewer.teams`.
4. I run the discovery block once against `-R acme/widgets`:
   - The `gh pr list` call searches `review-requested:@me -author:@me`, open PRs, `--limit 1000`, with the projection.
   - It exits 0.
   - The output is an array of 3 objects, each with an integer `number`. The count is below the limit.
5. Filtering and sorting:
   - No row is a draft, approved, or under change request, so no review lookup runs.
   - Sorted by size, then number: #101 (2 lines), #97 (4), #112 (6).
   - The current branch's PR 999 plays no part, because discovery never falls back to the current branch.
6. Ticket display:
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` names the default branch.
   - `git show <ref>:<overrides path>` yields `tracker: github`, which disables Linear IDs and lookups.
   - No PR has closing references.
   - The branches `retry`, `elapsed` and `trim-labels` carry no `gh-<N>`, and the titles carry no `#<N>`. Every PR shows `no ticket`.
7. Routing:
   - Three matches on Claude Code take the "2+ Claude Code" row: list, then stop.
   - No continuation record, tracker init, provisioning, verification or helper dispatch happens. No SHA is assessed.

The list goes in the visible text of the reply whose tool call reads the stop-format instructions: `skills/brainstorming/reference/menu-layout.md` (`## First-line rule`).

---

**Open PRs to gate, smallest first:**
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +1 -1, by sam, requested from you, no ticket - retries requests that are slow to respond
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +2 -2, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - shows how much time has elapsed
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +3 -3, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - trims labels that are empty
